niche.habitat: Nitride-vein canyons and hydrothermal basins where metal-rich brines pool under 40-bar pressure. Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): K'thar, k'thar consumes Fe-Ni nitrides directly from hydrothermal precipitates; Eridians harvest the same veins for carapace inlays and tool-casting. K'thar foraging destabilizes Eridian structural supports. Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): Krr-shatter, krr-shatter emits a focused infrasonic pulse that resonates with Fe-Ni inlays, inducing micro-fractures. Eridians must apply 'Dampening' (mud-caking) or shift resonance to avoid carapace failure. Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): Nimbus-wisp, nimbus-wisps use lipid bladders to drift in high-pressure currents, absorbing toxic ammonia clumps. Eridians groom wisps for clean slurry; wisps carry Eridian spores to new vent clusters using sound-guided flight. Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): Iron-back, iron-backs also use low-slung, multi-limbed crawling and Fe-Ni inlays. Divergence: Iron-backs rely on passive armor and ambush; Eridians use active tool-use and acoustic manipulation. Iron-backs cannot sinter metal, limiting them to scavenged ore.
niche.diet: Ammonia-assimilation grazer; metabolizes nitride-filaments and bio-sintered carbide crusts, recycling NH₃ into amidine polymers with urea-like slurry waste.
niche.active: Continuous; the opaque haze and slow rotation erase diurnal cues, so activity tracks thermal gradients and acoustic social rhythms.

body: A low-slung, multi-limbed crawler with a laminated carapace reinforced by bio-scavenged iron-nickel inlays that distribute load under 1.35 g and resist fracture. Fluid-filled internal cavities match the 40-bar ambient pressure, while vascularized thoracic flaps radiate metabolic heat to prevent overheating.

skill.effect: The creature pulses resonant clicks to scan the surroundings, making hidden foes clearly visible and holding nearby enemies in place for a short while.

chains.weakness: Dissonance burst stuns resonators; high frequencies cause feedback pain.

journal.en: They weave the world's shape from voice.

plausibility.summary: Treat 'stun 2s' as startle/disorientation from saturation or high SPL clicks, not neuromuscular paralysis; cap mapping at ~15–25 m given F8 haze and multipath clutter; prefer low-frequency calls (NH₃ absorption punishes highs, matching the dissonance weakness).
fixes: Treat 'stun 2s' as startle/disorientation from saturation or high SPL clicks, not neuromuscular paralysis; cap mapping at ~15–25 m given F8 haze and multipath clutter; prefer low-frequency calls (NH₃ absorption punishes highs, matching the dissonance weakness).

analogues.organism: Oilbird (Steatornis caripensis) and cave swiftlets—oral/head-region echolocation in visually depauperate habitats; horseshoe bats (Rhinolophidae) couple nasal/oral resonators to narrowband CF clicks.

skill.effect: It slams its heavy carapace against the ground to send a strong tremor outward, toppling light creatures and shattering fragile barriers nearby.

chains.weakness: Requires stable footing; slippery terrain nullifies tremor. Heavy armor slows movement.
observe: Metallic clatter on shell as they move
Glowing heat visible at joint inlays during exertion
Carrying a sintered metal shard or tool

journal.en: Their shells sing of the vents, and their tools answer back.

plausibility.summary: Frame 'super-strong' as carbide/nitride–ceramic matrices or diffusion-bonded laminates sintered at vent temperatures (F11/F20), not ambient 330 K steelmaking; keep inlays localized (F17) so carapace stays organomineral, not a full metal shell; Sonic Anvil as substrate-borne vibration is fine—don't imply the shell alone alloys on impact.
fixes: Frame 'super-strong' as carbide/nitride–ceramic matrices or diffusion-bonded laminates sintered at vent temperatures (F11/F20), not ambient 330 K steelmaking; keep inlays localized (F17) so carapace stays organomineral, not a full metal shell; Sonic Anvil as substrate-borne vibration is fine—don't imply the shell alone alloys on impact.

skill.effect: It opens its specialized gut to draw in surrounding ammonia fumes, replenishing its strength and drawing in friendly creatures that seek the same gas.

journal.en: They farm the air in their bellies. Their waste is poison to us, but a feast to the vents.

plausibility.summary: Macroscopic direct NH₃ diet is highly speculative— posit a symbiotic microbial guild (F12/F18) that fixes/assimilates reduced nitrogen, with the Eridian gut absorbing amino acids and excreting concentrated nitrogenous slurry (urea/urate-like); 'Nitrogen Tap' healing should read as environmental NH₃ uptake through symbionts or vent brines, not magic; oxidizer weakness stays; desiccation weakness fits ammonia-requiring water activity.
fixes: Macroscopic direct NH₃ diet is highly speculative— posit a symbiotic microbial guild (F12/F18) that fixes/assimilates reduced nitrogen, with the Eridian gut absorbing amino acids and excreting concentrated nitrogenous slurry (urea/urate-like); 'Nitrogen Tap' healing should read as environmental NH₃ uptake through symbionts or vent brines, not magic; oxidizer weakness stays; desiccation weakness fits ammonia-requiring water activity.

analogues.organism: Terrestrial nitrogen economy: plants and rhizobia assimilate NH₄⁺/fixed N; ureotelic birds/mammals excrete concentrated nitrogen waste (uric acid/urea) to save water—mechanism parallel, solvent swapped.

temperament: Deeply communal and inquisitive, communicating complex metallurgical knowledge through modulated thoracic hums that resonate through the dense atmosphere.
secrets: Electroreceptive ore-sense: They detect metal veins through solid rock using ampullary sensors, guiding migration to rich deposits.
Cultural pressure-sintering: They use geothermal heat and hydraulic pressure dies to forge carbide-nitride ceramics, a skill passed down socially.
moments: Mapping a dark cavern by listening to the harmonic echo of a jaw-thoracic click.
Sintering a metal shard against a hot vent to craft a tool, emitting a puff of ammonia spray.
Harmonizing with a distant herd to coordinate a migration across a nitride plateau.
